packageRules.description: GitHub Actions updates: one grouped PR, merged automatically once CI passes.
Camelot is std-only. Crates must never be added, so any Cargo update means a rule was broken: flag it, never automerge.
prBodyNotes: **Camelot is std only.** A Cargo dependency update means a crate was added somewhere; that breaks the project rules in CLAUDE.md. Remove the dependency instead of merging this.
